en: Abu Sa'id al-Hasan ibn Abi al-Hasan al-Basri
tr: Ebû Saîd el-Hasen b. Ebi'l-Hasen el-Basrî
ar: أبو سعيد الحسن بن أبي الحسن البصري

description.tr: İslam kelâmının öncüsü ve Basra fikir halkasının kurucusu || Hasan el-Basrî'nin halkası İslam'daki ilk organize fikir forumuydu. || [Tarih notu] Bazı eserlerin yazarlığı tartışmalıdır.
description.en: Pioneer of Islamic theology (kalām) and Basran intellectual circle; founded the tradition of rational theological discourse || Hasan al-Basri's circle was the first organized intellectual forum in Islam, producing both the Mu'tazila and the Ash'ari traditions. || [Historiographical note] His authorship of certain texts is debated; the Risāla ilā ʿAbd al-Malik is among the most securely attributed.
description.ar: رائد علم الكلام الإسلامي ومؤسس حلقة البصرة الفكرية || كانت حلقة الحسن البصري أول منتدى فكري منظم في الإسلام
